content: Comprehensive eye examinations are recommended to begin at the onset of puberty or at the age of 10 years, whichever occurs earlier, for individuals who have had type 1 diabetes for a duration of three to five years. These eye examinations should be repeated every two years. However, in certain cases, based on the individual's risk factors and hemoglobin A1C levels, an interval of up to four years between examinations may be considered sufficient.
